data_role: fit/select = K-shot support only (train/good); no /test/ touched in fitting; synthetic masks only for support-derived proxy objective (support synthetic adaptation)

channel_fit_frozen.normal_scale: MAD*1.4826 over clean support cells per channel
channel_fit_frozen.def_resp: median(value[inside syn mask]) - median(value[all cells]) per episode, self-centred

structure: per (cat, shot in {2,4}): for held-out support h in K, for held-out family f in 3 kinds: fit on (K-1 images x 2 non-held families x S seeds + nui), eval reduced-fused KNN AP on h's family-f episodes (synthetic masks). Rotate h and f.

gates_mechanism.G1: DNC-I vs random-mean AND vs low_nui >= +0.02 on >=2/3 held-out families (macro over cats)
gates_mechanism.G2: normal nuisance p99 (photometric, no mask) relative to full <= +10%
gates_mechanism.G3: DNC-C vs DNC-I set Jaccard < 0.95 and chosen cross-branch redundancy drops >=10%
gates_mechanism.G4: DNC-C vs DNC-I synthetic macro AP >= +0.003; shuffled/mismatch weakens by >=0.003

escalation: if G1/G2 pass and G3/G4 fail -> only DNC-I may run ONE frozen real diagnostic (call it channel adaptation, not fusion innovation); if G1/G2 fail -> archive, no real-mask run
real_gate_public: 6 cats, same shot macro vs A1 >= +0.006; per-shot non-negative; >=5/6 cats positive; worst >= -0.01; vs strongest equal-dim control >= +0.003; DNC-C vs DNC-I >= +0.003 for fusion claim
